full_judgment: Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury J: This petitioner by the defendant, Islamic Foundation, Bangladesh, arises out of an application for review of the judgment passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in FA No. 366 of 1995. The said appeal was from a judgment and decree of the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka in Title Suit. No. 171 of 1988. In that suit the predecessor of the respondents namely, Khaitunnessa, claimed herself to be the successive heiress of one Md. Ismail, a lessee in respect of the suit shop No. 49 and sought a declaration that she was entitled to continue as a lessee therein under the petitioner. She also prayed for recovery of khas possession of the suit shop. The petitioner contested the suit. But the trial Court decreed the suit on the findings that Md Ismail had been killed on 24 December 1971 and that plaintiff had acquired title to the suit shop by way of inheritance. On appeal the High Court Division confirmed the findings of the trial Court and dismissed the appeal. The petitioner then filed CP No. 242 of this Court, but got it dismissed as not pressed.
